source: l2jmobius PathFinding.findPath (NodeBuffer A*, GeoLocation, LOS postfilter) on the whole-world GeoEngine of the set
note: Cases are strings 'x y z tx ty tz instance playable > result', world coordinates, playable 0/1. result is 'null' (no path, no geodata, or no buffer large enough) or '<count> nodeX,nodeY,geoHeight,nswe ...' (GeoLocation.getNodeX/getNodeY/getZ/packed NSWE, in path order; getX/getY are the world middle of the node cell). Each variant sets the GeoEngineConfig pathfinding statics (weights are strings parsed as Java floats) and uses a fresh PathFinding; PathFinding = 2, AvoidObstructedPathNodes = true, PathFindBuffers = 100x6;128x6;192x6;256x4;320x4;384x4;500x2. Doors and fences: none. Start points are random cells of each region (70% preference for non-flat blocks, 20% near a region border); targets 1..350 cells away in a random direction (60% within 30, 25% within 100, 12% within 200, 3% beyond); extra cases: target on a completely blocked cell, same cell, neighbour cells, start in a region without a file. seed = 20260607 + variant * 1000003 + rx * 100 + ry.
